newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan oil basket down $1.21 to $15.92.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan oil basket down $1.21 to $15.92.

text.p: Venezuela's basket price of crude and oil products dropped $1.21 to $15.92 per barrel in the week to Friday, its second consecutive weekly drop, the Energy and Mines Ministry said.
International oil traders said the drop was in line with a fall in world prices due in part to an excessive offer.
Venezuela's average oil export price so far for June stood at $16.47, down from $16.69 in May, which was more than a dollar above the April average.
Since the beginnning of the year, the average price is $17.30 per barrel. In 1996 it was $18.39 per barrel, sharply up from $14.84 in 1995 and $13.23 in 1994.

The government, which gleans some 50 percent of its revenues from oil, has based 1997 budget calculations on an average price of $14.40 per barrel, although Energy and Mines Minister Erwin Arrieta has said he expects it to average higher than $15.50.
